victim_selection.notes: Not separately established for this subject. The access conditions recorded on USA-014-BITTAKER — the van acquired for abduction, young women in semi-public coastal space — are findings about the offences, and the opinion does not apportion the selection function between the two men on the text retrieved. Importing Bittaker's coding here would attribute conduct this record has not established, which is the error separate records exist to prevent. [SEARCH NOT EXHAUSTED — his trial testimony describes the division of roles and has not been read.]

signature_behaviour.notes: Null by design. The recording conduct recorded as signature_behaviour on USA-014-BITTAKER is attributed by the evidence to Bittaker: the tape was recovered from his van, he played a tape to a motel resident, and the photographs were his. Nothing in the retrieved record establishes recurrent non-necessary conduct by Norris. A signature belongs to the person the evidence attaches it to, not to the series.

motive_classification.notes: Deliberately null. The only account of Norris's participation and reasons is his own testimony, given under a plea agreement in which the death penalty was removed in exchange for it. That is the strongest incentive structure in criminal procedure, and coding a motive from testimony given under it would be coding a negotiated account. Compare USA-013-BROOKS and USA-010-BERKOWITZ, also null, for the same class of reason. The corroboration discussed under adjudication.confession_reliability bears on whether his account was true about events; it does not make it a reliable account of his own motivation.

spatial_pattern.notes: Not coded. As with USA-014-BITTAKER, no home base has been established against which to measure offence locations, and Canter & Larkin's distinction requires one. He had a room and an apartment — items of evidence were recovered from both — but neither has been located on this record. [SEARCH NOT EXHAUSTED — the search-warrant material in the opinion may establish an address, which would then be withheld from publication but could support the coding.]

detection_delay_factors.value: Minimal delay. He was arrested first, by the Hermosa Beach police department, after a surviving victim's photographic-lineup identification of Bittaker supported the warrant application. He had a prior felony record and had met Bittaker while both were inmates in state prison, so he was in state records throughout the four-to-five-month series.

confession_reliability.value: Given under the strongest available incentive, and corroborated by physical evidence. He pleaded guilty and testified for the prosecution under an agreement by which prosecutors did not seek the death penalty against him; his co-defendant received it. Independently of his account, the prosecution held an audio tape recovered from Bittaker's van, photographs of two victims, and an item belonging to a victim found in Norris's own apartment. He also led police to the remains of two victims, which were recovered and identified.

confession_reliability.notes: Both halves matter and neither cancels the other. An accomplice facing execution who is offered his life for testimony has every reason to say what the prosecution needs, including about the allocation of responsibility between himself and the man he is testifying against — and allocation is precisely what no physical evidence here corroborates. What the physical evidence does corroborate is that the events occurred and where two bodies lay, which is a great deal more than exists in USA-003-HALL and considerably more than exists for USA-013-BROOKS at count level. The honest summary is: strongly corroborated as to events, uncorroborated as to apportionment, obtained under an incentive that bears directly on apportionment.

trial_outcome.notes: No jury ever examined the evidence against him, and no special circumstances were found. The dataset records the conviction as established — a guilty plea is a conviction — while noting that the evidentiary record behind it was never adversarially tested. That is a different epistemic object from USA-014-BITTAKER's verdict, and analyses that treat all convictions as equivalent will miss it.

disposition.value: Died in custody at the California Medical Facility, Vacaville, in February 2020, after thirty-eight years in state prison. Found unsuitable for parole at his first hearing in 2009 and denied for ten years; denied again at his second hearing in March 2019, with no further hearing scheduled until 2029.

disposition.notes: Marked 'reported' because the death itself rests on a single tier-4 source. Note the custody discrepancy: CDCR placed him at Richard J. Donovan Correctional Facility in December 2019 and he died at the California Medical Facility roughly two months later, so he was transferred in the interval. Nothing is inferred from that. The practical effect of the sentence is that he was twice denied parole and died in prison — the outcome was the same as Bittaker's, reached by a different route and over the same span of years.

The circumstances of his questioning and the point at which plea negotiations began — material, because his statements became the narrative case against a man sentenced to death.
The division of roles between the two men, which his testimony describes and which has not been read in full. Several behavioural fields are null for this reason.
No clinical assessment located; no competency determination retrieved despite a guilty plea requiring one.

contested_points: The scope of the plea: five murders (Supreme Court opinion) or 'all counts' (CDCR).
The end of the offence period: October 1979 (opinion) or 20 November 1979 (CDCR). Both tier 1.
How far testimony given to avoid execution can establish the apportionment of responsibility between two co-offenders. Corroborated as to events; uncorroborated as to apportionment.
excluded_material: The names of all five deceased victims, and of the two survivors including the pseudonym in the published opinion — ETHICS.md.
All description of the offences and of the recorded material.
Any behavioural coding imported from USA-014-BITTAKER. Several fields here are null precisely because the evidence attaches the conduct to Bittaker and not to Norris.
The joint press epithet as a descriptor in this dataset's own voice.

Any characterisation of his cooperation as remorse or as its absence. The record establishes what he did procedurally and what it bought him; it establishes nothing about his state of mind, and ETHICS.md excludes reconstructed interiority.
